subtitles.text: Eons ago, a mage walked the Path of the Stars and, before its altar, wished for a power nothing in Creation could rival.
The wish was granted, and his ambition unleashed a March of Conquest that swept through kingdom after kingdom.
One lone mage, without an army or a title, stood before him to protect his people. The clash of both spells sealed the Dark Mage within the Path itself.
Centuries later, the world had forgotten the legend...
